Gifted: Prognostication.name: Gifted: Prognostication
Gifted: Prognostication.description:
🧬 Prognostication, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a reading shows about fifteen minutes of that person's future, once per person per day.
📈 Training adds throwing at where a read opponent will be, pulling someone out of a coming accident, having police waiting where a suspect will go, a full hour, several people at once and, at your peak, a whole day ahead.
⚠️ No touch or no eye contact, no reading; it never shows thoughts, and acting on a vision changes the future it showed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as a long reading leaves your own day blurry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Sir Nighteye's Foresight.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Prognostication.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Prognostication family): Scale: touch (skin or clothing) plus eye contact shows the user in a breath a person's next stretch as rapid scenes from beside them: where they go, whom they meet, what they say and do, what befalls them. At first about fifteen minutes ahead, once per person per day; longer, multi-person and combat readings: learned techniques. Limits: sunglasses, eye masks or shut eyes block it; the narrator never opens a refuser's eyes. It shows the course if nobody acts, never fate; acting branches it, the player stays free. Only events to and around them: never thoughts, memories or secrets they would not reveal then, nor the user's future except beside them. Quirk Strain: light: short reading, foreseen throw; moderate: saved accident, set trap, route reading; heavy: several people; severe: signature move, a full day. Type: Emitter. Law: a reading is a lead, never court evidence alone; stalking, blackmail or robbery by it is a crime.
